headline: Nguyen and Rick advance into ARC-2 top 40

sections.text: Nguyen gained 7.22 to reach 58.19, moving from 47th to 34th. Rick gained 7.36 to reach 54.86, moving from 51st to 40th.
The gains put both teams inside the top 40 on the public standings, with Nguyen 34th and Rick 40th.
